	}

	potential = {
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ap_ai } NOT = { has_country_flag = ap_vanilla_traditions } OR = { has_tradition = tr_ap_aptitude_adopt ap_tree_slot_free = yes }
		has_paragon_dlc = yes
	}

	ai_weight = {
		factor = 5
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.5
			is_gestalt = yes
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = @ap_pending_tradition_suppress
			has_ap_pending = yes
		}
	}
}
